datasets.name: cb77fad0
queryLines:
SELECT
  workspace_id,
  usage_date,
  usage_metadata.genie.surface,
  identity_metadata.run_as User,
  SUM(usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default) Genie_Cost,
  currency_code Currency,
  SUM(usage_quantity) LLM_DBUs
FROM
  system.billing.usage usage
    JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON usage.sku_name = lp.sku_name
      AND usage.cloud = lp.cloud
      AND price_start_time <= usage_start_time
      AND (
        price_end_time IS NULL
        or price_end_time >= usage_start_time
      )
WHERE
  usage_date >= '2026-07-06' -- pricing model change
  AND (
    array_contains(:interface_filter, usage_metadata.genie.surface)
    OR :interface_filter IS NULL
  )
  AND (
    (
      :time_range.min IS NULL
      AND :time_range.max IS NULL
    )
    OR usage_date BETWEEN CAST(:time_range.min AS DATE) AND CAST(:time_range.max AS DATE)
  )
  AND billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
  AND usage.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
  AND (
    array_contains(:workspace_filter, workspace_id)
    OR :workspace_filter IS NULL
  )
GROUP BY
  ALL

datasets.name: beca2628
queryLines:
WITH sql_query_workspaces AS ( -- default filter for global usage table, query history is regional table
  SELECT DISTINCT
    workspace_id AS wid
  FROM
    system.query.history
),
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Token cost estimation logic
filtered_usage AS ( -- shared billing usage
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    usage_start_time,
    DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', usage_start_time) AS time_bucket, -- reflects hourly granularity of usage table
    identity_metadata.run_as,
    usage_metadata.warehouse_id,
    usage_metadata.genie.agent_id,
    usage_metadata.genie.surface,
    cloud,
    sku_name,
    billing_origin_product,
    usage_quantity
  FROM
    system.billing.usage
  WHERE
    usage_date >= '2026-07-06' -- Genie billing model changes
    AND (
      (
        :workspace_filter IS NOT NULL
        AND array_contains(:workspace_filter, workspace_id)
      )
      OR (
        :workspace_filter IS NULL
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT
            1
          FROM
            sql_query_workspaces ws
          WHERE
            workspace_id = ws.wid
        )
      )
    )
    AND (
      (
        :time_bucket.min IS NULL
        OR usage_date >= CAST(:time_bucket.min AS DATE)
      )
      AND (
        :time_bucket.max IS NULL
        OR usage_date < CAST(:time_bucket.max AS DATE) + INTERVAL 1 DAY
      )
    )
),
genie_agent_llm AS ( -- token costs from billing
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    time_bucket,
    run_as,
    agent_id,
    CASE
      WHEN
        usage.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
      THEN
        usage_quantity * lp.pricing.effective_list.default
      ELSE 0
    END AS token_cost,
    CASE
      WHEN usage.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN usage.usage_quantity
      ELSE 0
    END AS free_dbus,
    CASE
      WHEN usage.sku_name != 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN usage.usage_quantity
      ELSE 0
    END AS paid_dbus,
    usage_quantity AS LLM_DBUs
  FROM
    filtered_usage usage
      LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON usage.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND usage.cloud = lp.cloud
        AND price_start_time <= usage_start_time
        AND (
          price_end_time IS NULL
          OR price_end_time >= usage_start_time
        )
  WHERE
    billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
    AND agent_id IS NOT NULL
    AND surface = 'GENIE_AGENTS'
    AND (
      array_contains(:agent_filter, agent_id)
      OR :agent_filter IS NULL
    )
),
genie_llm_bucketed AS ( -- bucketing & summing token costs
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    agent_id,
    run_as,
    time_bucket,
    SUM(token_cost) AS token_cost,
    SUM(paid_dbus) AS paid_dbus,
    SUM(free_dbus) AS free_dbus
  FROM
    genie_agent_llm
  GROUP BY
    ALL
),
wh_usage AS ( -- warehouse compute costs from billing
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    warehouse_id,
    time_bucket,
    usage_quantity,
    (pricing.effective_list.default * usage_quantity) AS wh_sql_costs
  FROM
    filtered_usage u
      JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND u.cloud = lp.cloud
        AND price_start_time <= usage_start_time
        AND (
          price_end_time IS NULL
          OR price_end_time >= usage_start_time
        )
  WHERE
    warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
    AND billing_origin_product = 'SQL'
),
wh_usage_bucketed AS ( -- summing up wh compute costs
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    warehouse_id,
    time_bucket,
    SUM(wh_sql_costs) AS wh_sql_costs,
    SUM(usage_quantity) AS wh_sql_dbus
  FROM
    wh_usage
  GROUP BY
    ALL
),
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Query History logic
wh_cpu_queries AS ( -- shared filtered query history
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    start_time,
    DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', start_time) AS time_bucket, -- reflects hourly granularity of usage table
    executed_by,
    compute.warehouse_id,
    query_source.genie_space_id,
    total_duration_ms,
    execution_duration_ms,
    total_task_duration_ms
  FROM
    system.query.history
  WHERE
    compute.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
    AND total_task_duration_ms > 0 -- skip queries without computational work
    AND total_duration_ms > 0
    AND (
      (
        :workspace_filter IS NOT NULL
        AND array_contains(:workspace_filter, workspace_id)
      )
      OR (
        :workspace_filter IS NULL
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT
            1
          FROM
            sql_query_workspaces ws
          WHERE
            workspace_id = ws.wid
        )
      )
    )
    AND start_time >= '2026-07-06' -- Genie billing changes
    AND (
      (
        :time_bucket.min IS NULL
        OR start_time >= CAST(:time_bucket.min AS DATE)
      )
      AND (
        :time_bucket.max IS NULL
        OR start_time < CAST(:time_bucket.max AS DATE) + INTERVAL 1 DAY
      )
    )
),
wh_queries_bucketed AS ( -- all wh queries
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    warehouse_id,
    time_bucket,
    COUNT(1) AS wh_num_queries,
    SUM(total_duration_ms) AS wh_total_duration_ms,
    SUM(execution_duration_ms) AS wh_exec_duration_ms,
    SUM(total_task_duration_ms) AS wh_cpu_time_ms
  FROM
    wh_cpu_queries
  GROUP BY
    ALL
),
genie_queries_bucketed AS ( -- subset of agentic wh queries
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    warehouse_id,
    time_bucket,
    genie_space_id,
    executed_by,
    COUNT(1) AS genie_num_queries,
    SUM(total_duration_ms) AS genie_total_duration_ms,
    SUM(execution_duration_ms) AS genie_exec_duration_ms,
    SUM(total_task_duration_ms) AS genie_cpu_time_ms
  FROM
    wh_cpu_queries
  WHERE
    genie_space_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      array_contains(:agent_filter, genie_space_id)
      OR :agent_filter IS NULL
    )
  GROUP BY
    ALL
),
genie_wh_queries AS ( -- combining preceding 2 CTEs for ratio calculations
  SELECT
    *,
    (genie_total_duration_ms / wh_total_duration_ms) AS genie_duration_ratio,
    (genie_cpu_time_ms / wh_cpu_time_ms) AS genie_cpu_ratio
  FROM
    genie_queries_bucketed JOIN wh_queries_bucketed USING (workspace_id, warehouse_id, time_bucket)
),
genie_space_costs AS ( -- determining sql costs per agent/wh/user/hour bucket
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    warehouse_id,
    genie_space_id AS agent_id,
    executed_by AS run_as,
    time_bucket,
    genie_cpu_ratio * wh_sql_costs AS genie_sql_costs,
    genie_cpu_ratio * wh_sql_dbus AS genie_sql_dbus,
    genie_num_queries,
    wh_sql_costs,
    wh_sql_dbus,
    wh_num_queries,
    genie_total_duration_ms,
    wh_total_duration_ms,
    genie_exec_duration_ms,
    wh_exec_duration_ms,
    genie_cpu_time_ms,
    wh_cpu_time_ms
  FROM
    genie_wh_queries JOIN wh_usage_bucketed USING (workspace_id, time_bucket, warehouse_id)
),
genie_space_costs_numbered AS ( -- adding row number column to avoid overcounting of token info
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY workspace_id, agent_id, run_as, time_bucket
        ORDER BY warehouse_id
      ) AS _rn
  FROM
    genie_space_costs
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(c.workspace_id, l.workspace_id) AS workspace_id,
  COALESCE(c.agent_id, l.agent_id) AS agent_id,
  COALESCE(c.run_as, l.run_as) AS run_as,
  COALESCE(c.time_bucket, l.time_bucket) AS time_bucket,
  c.warehouse_id,
  c.genie_sql_costs,
  c.genie_sql_dbus,
  c.genie_num_queries,
  c.wh_sql_costs AS _ref_wh_sql_costs, -- not suitable for downstream aggregations
  c.wh_sql_dbus AS _ref_wh_sql_dbus, -- not suitable for downstream aggregations
  c.wh_num_queries AS _ref_wh_num_queries, -- not suitable for downstream aggregations
  c.genie_total_duration_ms,
  c.genie_exec_duration_ms,
  c.genie_cpu_time_ms,
  c.wh_total_duration_ms AS _ref_wh_total_duration_ms, -- not suitable for downstream aggregations
  c.wh_exec_duration_ms AS _ref_wh_exec_duration_ms, -- not suitable for downstream aggregations
  c.wh_cpu_time_ms AS _ref_wh_cpu_time_ms, -- not suitable for downstream aggregations
  CASE -- avoids overcounting if warehouse changed within a time bucket, costs assigned to first
    WHEN
      c._rn = 1
      OR c.warehouse_id IS NULL
    THEN
      l.token_cost
    ELSE 0
  END AS token_cost,
  CASE -- avoids overcounting if warehouse changed within a time bucket, dbus assigned to first
    WHEN
      c._rn = 1
      OR c.warehouse_id IS NULL
    THEN
      l.paid_dbus
    ELSE 0
  END AS paid_dbus,
  CASE -- avoids overcounting if warehouse changed within a time bucket, dbus assigned to first
    WHEN
      c._rn = 1
      OR c.warehouse_id IS NULL
    THEN
      l.free_dbus
    ELSE 0
  END AS free_dbus
FROM
  genie_space_costs_numbered c
    FULL OUTER JOIN genie_llm_bucketed l
      ON c.workspace_id = l.workspace_id
      AND c.agent_id = l.agent_id
      AND c.run_as = l.run_as
      AND c.time_bucket = l.time_bucket

lines:
Made by [https://www.linkedin.com/in/bigdatadude/](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bigdatadude/) This dashboard tracks **Databricks Genie AI Assistant** usage and estimates LLM token and compute costs across your account. It consists of the following pages: **Genie Token Costs**: Paid LLM token cost tracking. Focuses exclusively on paid Genie usage (excludes the free allowance SKU). Provides both:
> Daily view: Granular cost trends over time, filterable by interface and workspace
> Monthly rollup: Aggregated cost per month (intentionally ignores the date range filter for full-history visibility) **Genie Compute Costs**: Covers estimated SQL query costs & counts and LLM token costs & DBU usage of Genie Agents per user and warehouse on hourly and daily granularities. Visualisations include:
> Estimated warehouse costs per agent
> Warehouse costs per agent per day
> SQL costs per warehouse
> SQL query volume per warehouse
See the bottom of this page for an explanation for the estimation logic. **Genie Free Allowance**: Free DBU allowance monitoring. Tracks daily and monthly consumption of the free LLM allowance per user and Genie interface. Includes current-month usage against the 150 DBU/user limit for Genie Code. Visualisations include:
> Pie chart: Recent months' free DBU use by user
> Histogram: Daily free DBU consumption over time by user
> Bar chart: Current month's free DBU use for Genie Code
> Histogram: Daily Genie Code interaction counts (from assistant events, not billing) **Genie Interfaces**: Helps identify which interface is driving the most usage. Detailed breakdown across Genie Code, Genie Agents, and Genie One including per-surface pivot totals, top users by token cost, agent-level consumption, and daily interaction counts.
All quantities displayed (like DBU usages and costs) are estimates, based on (effective) list prices, and may differ from actual invoiced amounts. Additional caveats apply, for example: - Free LLM DBU usage tracking starts after 20/07/2026 due to system table limitations - Paid LLM DBU usage tracking starts after 06/07/2026 due to system table limitations - The system.query.history table used for the *Genie Compute Costs* page is "regional" so only records from workspaces in the dashboard's region are available
The following system tables are queried: - system.billing.usage: For retrieving billing records to estimate Genie LLM consumption, used in every page - system.query.history: For accessing warehouse query information, only needed in the *Genie Compute Costs* page - system.billing.list\_price: For retrieving effective list prices to estimate costs - system.access.assistant\_events: For retrieving user interaction events with Genie Code
### Dashboard Filters The following filters are available: | Filter | Scope | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Workspace ID** | All pages | Scope to one or more workspaces | | **Date Range** | All pages | Restrict the time window for daily and monthly charts | | **Genie Interface** | All pages | Filter by `GENIE_CODE`, `GENIE_AGENTS`, or `GENIE_ONE` | | **Agent IDs** | *Genie Compute Costs* only | Restrict to one or more Genie Agents available in the workspace |
### Compute Cost Estimations The *Genie Compute Costs* page estimates the SQL costs of Genie Agents, other surfaces like Genie Code will be covered soon. Its central *GenieComputeCosts* dataset combines records from the system.billing.usage table with system.billing.list\_price and system.query.history. The latter is a regional table so agents in workspaces from other cloud regions are not visible. In Databricks system tables, individual query records do not have a dedicated cost column and usage rows cannot be directly joined with query history records for estimation purposes as necessary metadata is missing and usage records have an "hourly granularity". Furthermore, warehouses are shared compute resources, so queries from multiple users may run on the same warehouse concurrently. There is no single best answer to how query costs should be calculated in such scenarios, the *GenieComputeCosts* dataset assigns estimates based on the "computational work" that was required to answer agentic queries. The underlying query of the *Genie Compute Costs* dashboard page calculates two cost streams for an agent independently and merges them based on identical time buckets. **SQL costs ** are attributed proportionally using a CPU-time ratio approach: - From the query history table, each Genie agent's "computational work time" is calculated per slot and the "total cpu time" of each warehouse is determined per hourly bucket. This approach ignores queries without any cluster computations, for example failed ones or queries that received their results directly from a caching layer. - An agent's cpu time share is divided by a warehouse's total cpu time from the same bucket which results in a "cpu time ratio" - This ratio gets multiplied by a warehouse's total billing cost from the usage table during the associated hourly bucket: If an agent consumed 30% of a warehouse's CPU time in a given hour, it is attributed 30% of that hour's warehouse bill. But if the warehouse served a Genie Agent exclusively during this time slot, the proportion would be 1 so the agent is assigned the full warehouse costs for that hour. An agent's **LLM token DBUs/costs** are estimated with a method similar to other dashboard pages but all records are bucketed per . LLM cost is "DBU usage quantity × effective list price" for paid SKUs, or zero for GENIE\_FREE\_USAGE. When an agent used multiple warehouses within an hourly bucket, its LLM info will only get assigned to the first warehouse row so overcounting is avoided. At the end, the SQL costs are merged with the LLM quantities via a full outer join on so agents with only token costs (no SQL queries) or only SQL costs (no billing LLM line) still appear. For more info, see the actual query and comments in the *GenieComputeCosts* dataset.
